source: CoO Risk / Value Realization team (placeholder taxonomy)

risks.name: Technology & Cybersecurity Risk
risks.definition: Risk that the initiative introduces or amplifies exposure to cyber threats, data breaches, system outages, or privacy incidents through new systems, integrations, or data handling.

risks.name: Operational & Change Management Risk
risks.definition: Risk that staff cannot adopt the new process, that training or change support is inadequate, or that operational disruption occurs during transition.

risks.name: Financial & Budget Risk
risks.definition: Risk that the initiative exceeds budget, fails to realize projected savings, or creates unanticipated ongoing operating costs.

risks.name: Regulatory & Compliance Risk
risks.definition: Risk of non-compliance with applicable legislation, regulation, council directive, or accessibility / privacy obligations.

risks.name: Reputational & Public Trust Risk
risks.definition: Risk that the initiative damages public trust through poor service experience, perceived bias, lack of transparency, or visible failure.

risks.name: Vendor & Third-Party Risk
risks.definition: Risk arising from dependence on third-party vendors — service continuity, lock-in, performance, security posture, or contractual terms.

risks.name: Data Quality & Decision Risk
risks.definition: Risk that decisions based on the system are flawed due to inaccurate, incomplete, biased, or stale data.
